I have farmed this millet plot for more than thirty years, and I know what works on my soil. Last season I bought one bag of NPK fertilizer from the agro-dealer and carried goat manure from my compound, and the harvest was enough to feed my family. I will use my own saved seed again and do the weeding with my wife and sons, because hiring labor is money I do not have when the rains are uncertain. I do not use chemicals or irrigation — the rain will come when Allah wills it, and millet is a hardy crop if you keep the weeds away.
